# Buzz UI package receipt

`el-buzz-ui-0.1.0-d7625ff2232c.tgz` is the React-only `@el/buzz-ui` 0.1.0 package built from the
canonical `packages/ui/Buzz` source in el-lander commit
`888cc1009` on `codex/DEV-11398-el-buzz-theme-library`:
https://gitlab.com/vertical-int/enrich-layer/el-lander/-/commit/888cc1009

SHA-256: `d7625ff2232c391fbfbd5450b5963b95808a856110649a2eaa5d666f0d8a3c4c`

The archive includes Apache-2.0 LICENSE and NOTICE attribution for the preview
adapted from block/buzz. It has no runtime dependencies beyond React peers.

Build with `node scripts/build-package-dist.mjs packages/buzz-ui` in el-lander,
then `pnpm --dir packages/buzz-ui/dist pack --pack-destination ../../../.tmp/buzz-package`.
Copy the archive here using its new SHA-256 prefix and update the desktop file
dependency with `pnpm add --ignore-scripts @el/buzz-ui@file:../vendor/<archive>`.

The independent plugin manifest in `desktop/public/plugins/el-buzz.json` is
generated by `node scripts/export-buzz-theme.mjs` in el-lander.
